_description: Split config for MEDITECH EHI export analysis. MEDITECH documents 2 export configurations that apply to different product platforms. Config 1 (HIM/SCN/PHM-based: eChart + FHIR + C-CDA) covers newer platforms. Config 2 (MRI/DR-based: CSV + FHIR + C-CDA) covers older platforms. Some platforms support both configs depending on acute vs ambulatory deployment.

splits.focus: MEDITECH Expanse platform (newest generation). Uses Config 1 (HIM/SCN/PHM-based): Electronic Chart documents + US Core FHIR + C-CDA + supplemental clinical/admin/financial reports. Covers both acute and ambulatory settings.

MEDITECH 6.x platform (6.1 and 6.0 generations). 6.1/6.15 acute uses Config 1 (HIM/SCN/PHM-based: eChart + FHIR + C-CDA). 6.0 acute uses Config 1. 6.0 ambulatory uses Config 2 (MRI/DR-based: CSV + FHIR + C-CDA). Assess which config applies to each sub-product.
products: MEDITECH 6.1 Electronic Health Record Core HCIS
MEDITECH 6.0 Electronic Health Record Core HCIS

splits.focus: MEDITECH legacy platforms: Client/Server and MAGIC. Acute settings use Config 1 (HIM/SCN/PHM-based). Both acute and ambulatory settings can use Config 2 (MRI/DR-based: CSV + FHIR + C-CDA). These are maintenance-only platforms with different architectures from modern MEDITECH.
